interview.secured: A day is secured when I finish every task in the challenge that day, like walking 7,000 steps and posting my proof; the Activity screen says a day only counts when every task is done.
interview.freeze: The screens I can see here never clearly explained what a freeze is, so I'm only guessing that it might protect a streak if I miss a day.
interview.selfReported: I think it means the app is trusting me to say I did the task rather than verifying it, but I can't point to a clear explanation from what I saw.
interview.tomorrow: 6 - The 7K Steps challenge is simple and I like seeing days get secured, but the leaderboard was only gray loading placeholders and a couple of terms weren't clear.

goals.text: You joined a challenge in GRIIT on an earlier day and finished that day. Today you open the app again. Do whatever you think you need to do today, and look at your streak. Say in your thought what the app tells you about yesterday.
